integrity: The proof computes every subgroup measure through the F_p-dimension of its image and the F_q-dimension of its field span, then identifies all centralizers by symplectic orthogonal complementation. Exhaustive finite-field checks cover prime and non-prime field cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard finite-field Heisenberg group, not Heisenberg groups over Z/p^aZ.
The n=1 quasi-antichain boundary is prior work.
A public faculty page lists the Chermak-Delgado lattice of finite Heisenberg groups as active research, leaving a residual unpublished-overlap risk.
title: The Chermak–Delgado lattice of a finite Heisenberg group is a subspace lattice
